name: die Naturen
roots: Natur (natura); Seinsweise (a mode of being); Wesen (from wesan, to be, to dwell)

name: Körper
roots: Körper (Latin corpus); Leib (Old High German lîb, life: the lived body) — a stone is Körper and has no Leib, and the law's body is the first

name: das Sagbare
roots: sagen (to say); lesen (to gather, to read — as a vintage is a Lese: Heidegger's λέγειν as legen and lesen, laying together)

name: Gattung
roots: gatten (to join, to match: what is joined as alike); Art (a kind)

name: die Ordnung der Körper
roots: Ordnung (order); Schichtenbau (Nicolai Hartmann: the strata of the real world, each higher one resting on the lower, carried by it and free above it)

name: Elementarteilchen
roots: Element (elementum); Teilchen (a little part, from Teil)

name: Population
roots: populus; Bestand (a stand of trees, what stands together)

name: Lebensgemeinschaft
roots: Leben + Gemeinschaft (gemein, common); Biozönose (βίος + κοινός, Möbius 1877)

name: Ökosystem
roots: οἶκος; Haushalt der Natur (nature's household: Haeckel's Oekologie, 1866)

name: Stoff
roots: Stoff (stuff); Materie (materia); Werkstoff (a material made to be worked)

name: Gestein
roots: Stein (a stone): Gestein, stone in mass

name: Gerät
roots: Old High German girâti (provision, equipment — kin to Rat, what is provided)

name: Anlage
roots: anlegen (to lay out, to lay on)

name: Liebe
roots: Liebe; Agape; sie sucht nicht das Ihre (1 Kor 13:5)

name: Urheber
roots: ur- (origin) + heben (to raise): the one who first raised it; Schöpfer (the Creator) is THE ONE's

name: Zeit
roots: Zeit (from a root meaning to divide: a portion — kin to tide)

name: befindet sich
roots: sich befinden (to find oneself); Lage (where a thing lies)

name: Verantwortlicher
roots: Antwort (an answer): the one who answers

name: Handlungen
roots: Hand (the hand): what is handled, done

name: abgeleitet
roots: ableiten (to lead off, as a channel from a stream)

name: abgelesen
roots: ablesen (to read off, as a dial is read); lesen (to gather — as a vintage is a Lese)

name: Schichten
roots: schichten (to stack in order); Hartmann's strata of being

name: Gesetz
roots: setzen (to set): what is set down

name: Begründung
roots: Grund (the ground): laying the ground, as a Gesetzesbegründung

name: Warteschlange
roots: warten (to wait, to watch over); anhängig (pending: hanging on)

name: Ansicht
roots: sehen (to see); Ansicht (a view in a technical drawing)

name: Verstehen
roots: verstehen (to stand before, to grasp); Dilthey's Verstehen

name: Betrieb
roots: treiben (to drive): a plant in Betrieb is running

name: Garten
roots: Garten (an enclosure; kin to yard); Paradies
